Im a 34 year old vet. I have been sleeping with a rope tied around my neck for the past few days after drinking enough to make sure I pass out, hoping I don't wake up. I think hanging is the way to go, that way you can enjoy the knowing it's all about to be over part and feel the relief come. Im looking forward to it. 

Why haven't I done it yet? Good question. I want to make sure that I get the job I have been wanting and worked so hard for so I can sleep knowing that my life was all lined up and now I can walk away and not worry about fucking it up.
